summary: Created a safe inventory of real log/report artifact candidates for future VLA dry-run JSONL conversion using only the declared candidate listing command and declared read-only schema/report files.
commands_run: find logs rack_hybrid_docking_package/logs -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.log' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.jsonl' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.txt' \) -size -2M | sort | head -200 > .ai_agents/review/real_log_candidates.txt
key_logs: Generated .ai_agents/review/real_log_candidates.txt from declared logs directories only
Read the VLA contract, positive validation report, negative validation report, and generated candidate list with declared sed commands
Inventory classifies candidate groups as high, medium, low, or unknown
OK: result stays within declared commands, allowed files, and status set
issues: Candidate log/report bodies were not inspected because no task command was declared for reading individual candidate files.
Signal availability is conservative and filename/schema based until a follow-up task explicitly reads one selected small bundle.
Media-state candidates were not strongly represented in the generated candidate list.
next_recommendation: Create task_0009_convert_one_dryrun_bundle_to_vla_jsonl to read one selected high-value dry-run bundle, convert a capped sample to VLA dry-run JSONL, and validate it with the existing static validator.
